togething.title: Togething
togething.description: Social React Native app for small wins, goal storylines, community support, and coaching — on the App Store and Google Play.
togething.longDescription: Togething is a community built to help people change their story through small steps and celebrated wins. Users create storylines, share steps, support each other, find accountability partners, and request coaching. Basic features are permanently free with no ads.

features.0: Storylines, shared steps, and positive social reinforcement
features.1: Accountability partners, groups, and real-time chat
features.3: Watching, daily steps, notifications, and watcher invites

results.0: Published on the App Store and Google Play
results.1: Improved screen load speed and reduced loading time by ~35%

hudu.title: HUDU
hudu.description: AI-powered odd-job marketplace built with React Native — list projects, receive bids, chat, and pay through escrow.
hudu.longDescription: HUDU is an AI-powered gig marketplace that connects Listers and local Doers. Users post projects, review competitive bids, chat in-app, and release escrowed payments when work is complete. Built and maintained as a large React Native application with performance-focused UI and API integrations.

features.0: Project listings with photos and requirements
features.1: Competitive bidding, in-app chat, and Doer profiles

results.0: Published on Google Play under the HUDU developer listing

compressa.title: Compressa | فشرده‌یار
compressa.description: Kotlin Android app for compressing images, video, and PDF with Jetpack Compose and clean architecture.
compressa.longDescription: Compressa (فشرده‌یار) is an Android media compression app built with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. It supports image, video, and PDF compression, multi-select queues with a foreground service, before/after results, history, duplicate scanning, and large-file scanning — with Persian/English and RTL/LTR.

features.0: Image, video, and PDF compression engines
features.1: Compression queue with foreground service and progress
features.2: Before/after results, history, and media viewer
features.3: Duplicate and large-file scanners with Persian/English RTL/LTR

compressa.architecture: Clean feature modules with Compose UI, use cases, media engines, DataStore preferences, and SQLite history.

noteapp-aspnet.title: NoteApp ASP.NET
noteapp-aspnet.description: ASP.NET Core Web API for personal notes with JWT auth, EF Core, and SQL Server.
noteapp-aspnet.longDescription: A note-taking backend built with ASP.NET Core. It exposes Auth and Notes controllers, uses Entity Framework Core with SQL Server, JWT Bearer authentication, DTOs, and Swagger for API exploration.

features.2: EF Core data layer with migrations
features.3: DTOs, auth service, and Swagger with Bearer scheme

noteapp-aspnet.architecture: ASP.NET Core Web API with Controllers, Services, DTOs, Models, Data, and EF Core migrations.

portfolio-website.title: Web Portfolio
portfolio-website.description: Personal resume and portfolio website with React, TypeScript, and Vite.
portfolio-website.longDescription: Professional site showcasing experience, skills, and projects with modern React tooling.
portfolio-website.problem: Need a maintainable portfolio that reflects senior mobile and frontend experience.
portfolio-website.solution: Feature-oriented React app with typed content models, i18n, and a shared design system.

features.1: About, resume, skills, and projects pages
features.2: Light/dark theme, i18n, and validated forms
